title: Hinomori Shizuku — Happy Birthday!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy  - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, that should be everything we need to do for today's stream...

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Great!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for doing all this, everyone. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't say that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's your birthday, right?
Of course, we're gonna do everything we can for it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm sure your fans can't wait to celebrate your birthday, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of fans...
You may want to head back to class a little early, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?
Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Student Fan
rows.Line: I hope Shizuku gets here soon...

rows.Speaker: Younger Fan
rows.Line: Wow... I never dreamed of being able to give her a present in person like this...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Ah, I see...
So this is what you meant, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup. Shizuku wasn't at school much last year because of work, so everybody sent her presents and stuff through her agency...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But now she's here! I can see why they'd want to hand her a present in person!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But so many...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Still, I'd like to show them my appreciation since I have an opportunity to do it in person...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, I'll go.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Sh-Shizuku?!
Won't you cause a panic by barging in like that?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, she should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good morning, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Student Fan
rows.Line: Sh-Shizuku...! No, you're glowing too brightly!

rows.Speaker: Younger Fan
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
As beautiful as ever...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, they're worshipping her like some sort of goddess and are too scared to go near her...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. Pretty much all of Shizuku's fans are like this...

rows.Speaker: Student Fan
rows.Line:
Shizuku...! U-Uhh...
H-Here's your birthday present...

rows.Speaker: Younger Fan
rows.Line: I... I brought one too!

rows.Speaker: Student Fan
rows.Line: Me too! Please, if you will!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
I don't know what to say♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How about we do this? Would you all mind forming a line so that I can talk to all of you one at a time?

rows.Speaker: Student Fan
rows.Line:
Wh-What...?!
O-One at a time...?!

rows.Speaker: Younger Fan
rows.Line:
I get to talk with Shizuku...?!
Yes, I'll line up immediately...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, look at that! They formed a pair of lines so quickly!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not only that, they're being careful not to block the doorway.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! They're making sure not to cause anyone else any trouble! That's so considerate of them!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's Shizuku for you.
She should be just fine on her own now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and we'll be there if anything does come up.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Have fun, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you! I will!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, Shizuku. Looks like that's it for everyone that initially lined up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it seems that way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm so glad I was able to do this.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Student Fan
rows.Line: I was so moved by what you said when MORE MORE JUMP! started doing streams, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Student Fan
rows.Line: I didn't realize just how hard you had to work to give us the best performances possible...!

rows.Speaker: Younger Fan
rows.Line: You said, “I may not be perfect,” then, but you're still the best, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Younger Fan
rows.Line: That show you did for those elementary school students was so incredible too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (What I said, our performances... It's all reaching them...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Thank goodness...)
Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Saki, Ichika, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Good morning!
We heard that you were accepting presents, so we decided to stop by♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We tried to get Shiho to join us, but she said that it'd be too embarrassing to celebrate at school and wants to wait until you're both back home.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you for trying.
Shii actually already wished me a happy birthday this morning when we were at home.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My family's also planning on having some cake together later tonight.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That sounds like a lovely evening. I'm sure it'll be a wonderful celebration.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I sure hope so! My heart's already racing out of sheer excitement!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm glad you got a chance to celebrate with everyone like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. I even got some little-birdie goods from some of them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This present is meant to show my appreciation for everything you've done for me, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I really hope you get a chance to use this!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, the little birdie I brought is more of an ornamental item, but I hope you like it...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I should be showing my appreciation for them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Especially since they're so close with your little sister.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, exactly.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (They all decided to chase after the same dream and join Shii in trying to become professional musicians...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And I can relate with what they're likely going through since we as a group are chasing after a similar dream.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Knowing that her friends are there trying with her must be such a happy feeling for Shii.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I can't thank them enough.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You can thank each of them when their respective birthdays roll around, you know?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I should put all my presents in my desk and organize them somehow before homeroom starts...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. You don't have much time, so I'll lend you a hand.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Airi!
I'll...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh! Good morning, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Good morning, and happy birthday. I noticed the line in front of your class just now, but didn't have anything ready...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It's okay, really.
Your thoughts are more than enough, so thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Really? Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Still, I was pretty startled by what just happened. That line went all the way down to the end of the corridor.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I really wasn't expecting that either. So many students all in one place.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You weren't expecting them?
Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Based on how hard you work day in and day out, I wasn't surprised at all to see so many people visiting to wish you a happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Asahina...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see. In that case, I couldn't be happier.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (That means we're really spreading and inspiring hope in everyone, together.)
